test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was the first development bank in India?
solution:
The correct answer is the__** Industrial Finance Corporation of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Industrial Finance Corporation of India

 
 
• ​It was established on July 1, 1948
 
• The primary goal of establishing this development bank was to help the industrial sector meet its medium- and long-term financial demands.
 
• The IFCI's authorized capital is 250 crores.
 
• People's deposits are not accepted
 
• When a firm issues shares or debentures, the Industrial Finance Corporation of India may choose to underwrite securities.
 
• The IFCI also insures the loans that these industrial enterprises take out.
 
• It also ensures deferred payments for loans taken out in foreign currency from foreign banks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

__
 
• The National Housing Bank Act,1987 envisaged the setting up of National Housing Bank (NHB) in 1988.

 
 
• National Housing Bank is an apex-level financial institution for promoting the housing sectors at both regional and local levels.
 
• The Head office of NHB is in New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **The Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank) **is a financial institution of India that was established on 1 January 1982 under the Export-Import Bank of India Act 1981__.
 
 
• Its main objective is to provide financial assistance to promote Indian exports.
 
 
 
• Industrial Development Bank of India was established in 1964 and came into operation on July 1, 1964, to provide credit and other financial facilities for the development of industries in India.
 
 
• IDBI Bank has been categorized as a private sector bank by the Reserve Bank of India, with effect from January 21, 2019.
